params.body:
Shane, staging, 15 September 2026, after PR 426/448: dragging a photo tile did nothing, tiles stayed on "Kopie maken…" after the copy was done, the platform copy came back on a white ground without the dealer background, and the background choice was asked on "Blur weghalen" instead of on the copy. Four root causes, one PR.

## Drag to reorder (R S1-6.33)

Reproduced locally with the built bundle at 1440 px: `$.fn.sortable` exists, both grids are bound (`data('slSortable')`), the grip carries `fas fa-grip-vertical` (the rule survives the purge) and a drag **by the grip** moved the tile and fired `PUT changeImageOrder` with "Volgorde bewaard". What did nothing was a drag **by the photo**, which is what dealers did for years with jQuery UI: the photo is a lightbox link since September and the own sortable never starts a drag on a link. Now the handle is the grip and the photo link; a handle wins over the link rule, a click without movement still opens the lightbox, a real drag swallows the click that follows it (capture on the grid, once). The `grabbing` cursor is set on the body only while dragging, so the grip keeps `cursor: grab` at rest; it stays visible on the desktop.

## Copies appear when done (R S1-6.29)

The server already served the new `polling.js` (`$.get`) at 15:42 UTC, but the sheets loaded it as `/js/vehicle/polling.js?v=2` and Forge serves `/js/*` with `Cache-Control: max-age=2592000`. A browser that had the sheet open before the deploy kept the previous poller under the same URL for thirty days; that one POSTed, got 419 on every turn, and the tiles stayed as the request had set them. The three sheets now load `polling.js` with `?v={{ filemtime }}` like `create.js` next to it. The swap itself (`.html(view)` on the `<li>`, fresh tile `data-processing="false"`, `onPolled` recounts) matches the poll's payload (`success`, `data[].id/view/failed`, `queued`, `processing`).

## Dealer background on the copy (R S1-6.4)

Three readers of the same `settings` rows gave three answers: the settings pane reads the dealer's own rows, the photo tab took the **last** row per key (`SettingComposer`), the remove.bg call took the **first** (`pluck(...)[0]`). The table has a row per key per dealer, some empty, so the tab could offer two backgrounds while the job read an empty row and attached no `bg_image_file` at all. One rule now, `App\Support\BackgroundImage::name`: the vehicle's dealer's row with a value, then the platform row (`dealer_id` null), then any row with a value; the tab and the job both read it. Every call logs `remove.bg: request` with the background name and `background_bytes`; a configured background missing on disk (`storage/app/public/dealer_backgrounds`, local disk, not the bucket) is a `warning`. Dealer 4's production rows cannot be read from this machine: after the deploy, one copy's log line says whether bytes left; 0 with a warning means the file must be re-uploaded under Instellingen, Achtergrond.

## Background choice on the right actions (R S1-6.6)

`askBackground(vraag, uitleg, then, anders, metKeuze)`: the swatches are asked on "Achtergrond verwijderen" and on "Naar Stocklist kopiëren" (bulk and per tile, new `ui.copy_confirm` texts in four languages, `data-q-copy` on the gallery); "Blur weghalen" (bulk and tile) is a plain confirmation. No sets the bulk spinner back.

## Tests

`PhotoReorderTest` (grip icon, handle, click swallow, cursor, no fixed `?v=2`), `PhotoTabToolbarTest` (dialog per action, the unblur button passes `false`, the copy texts), `RemoveBackgroundTest` (an empty row of another dealer does not hide the platform background, the dealer's row wins, light by `background_type`, the byte log, the missing-file warning). Filter `PhotoTabToolbar|PhotoReorder|RemoveBackground|CompiledViews|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|BuildContract|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity`: OK (44 tests, 1182 assertions). Rules S1-6.4, S1-6.6 and S1-6.33 updated; four findings under `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-*`.

Verified in Playwright at 1440: drag by grip and by photo both fire the PUT, the platform grid too; click opens the lightbox, not after a drag; copy and remove-background open the swatch dialog, unblur the plain confirmation.

## Note

Rebased on main after PR 461 (which restored the `ui-lang-*` rules); this PR no longer touches `refresh.css`. Supersedes #462.
params.title: Photo tab: drag saves, copies appear when done, and carry the dealer background
